Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: The check now walks the listing by offset to the reported total instead of reading one page -- their 2026-09-11 ~04:35 release made offset work, and a one-page read could not see a card beyond the first window become reachable -- and it leaves user-submitted cards out of its witness set, because by their own stated design a user submission is visible only to its author and is not part of the public market. The one witness still missing after the walk, a4a5b71e, is user 99's submission; that it is readable by account 113 at all is a visibility defect with its own check, not a listing defect. The original failure this row was opened on is documented in report #90. Pinned under the new definition, under which every public tradeable witness is found among the 6,880 walked cards.

RUN: run-20260911T055512Z-0d595c5b, preregistration PRE-0095, on a clean working tree at commit 0d595c5b8a495230ba9631cd6f686959cab2ec87. The selector was frozen and git-tagged BEFORE the run, so the set of checks could not be narrowed after seeing the results.
